source.source_title: OAVS PGT Computer Science — Annexure VI
source.source_recruitment_context: Referenced from OAVS Teacher Syllabus 2026 preparation source
source.notes: Annexure-VI "Syllabus for written examination for PGT (Computer Science)". Structured into study units; wording to be verified line-by-line against the PDF.

topics.name: Computer Organisation Basics
topics.source_text: Basic organisation of a computer: CPU, memory, input/output units and their interconnection.

subtopics.name: Bus structure: data, address and control bus

topics.name: Instruction Set and Addressing
topics.source_text: Instruction formats, instruction types and addressing modes.

topics.name: Central Processing Unit
topics.source_text: CPU organisation, registers, ALU and control unit design.

topics.name: Memory Organisation
topics.source_text: Memory hierarchy, main memory, cache and virtual memory.

topics.name: Input-Output Organisation
topics.source_text: Peripheral devices, I/O interface and modes of data transfer.

topics.name: Operating System Fundamentals
topics.source_text: Definition, functions and types of operating systems.

topics.name: Processes
topics.source_text: Process concept, process states and process control block.

topics.name: Deadlocks
topics.source_text: Deadlock model, prevention, avoidance and recovery.

topics.name: Memory Management
topics.source_text: Allocation of main memory to processes.

topics.name: File Systems
topics.source_text: File concepts, access methods and directory structures.

topics.name: Number Systems
topics.source_text: Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal number systems and conversions.

topics.name: Codes
topics.source_text: Binary codes used in digital systems.

topics.name: Visual Basic Environment
topics.source_text: Introduction to the Visual Basic IDE and event-driven programming.

subtopics.name: IDE: toolbox, properties window, project explorer

topics.name: Procedures and Functions
topics.source_text: Sub procedures, function procedures and built-in functions.

subtopics.name: Built-in string, math and date functions

topics.name: Controls and Events
topics.source_text: Working with standard and ActiveX controls.

topics.name: Arrays
topics.source_text: One- and two-dimensional arrays and their operations.

subtopics.name: Call by value and call by reference

topics.name: Structured Data Types
topics.source_text: Arrays, strings, structures and user-defined types.

subtopics.name: Dynamic memory allocation: new and delete

topics.name: Word Processing
topics.source_text: Document preparation with a word processor.

subtopics.name: Text, graphics, audio, video and animation
Bus, star, ring and tree topologies
Wireless and mobile communication: GSM, CDMA
